title: Maxwell's EM Wave Propagation
subtitle: Orthogonal E & B Vector Fields & Poynting Energy Flow
description: True 3D vector field visualization of an electromagnetic wave derived from Maxwell's equations. Displays mutually perpendicular transverse Electric field E vectors (Cyan), Magnetic field B vectors (Rose), and the longitudinal Poynting energy propagation vector S = 1/μ₀(E × B).
formulaCompact: E(z,t) = E_0 sin(kz - wt) j_hat; B(z,t) = B_0 sin(kz - wt) k_hat;

parameters.label: Wave Frequency (ω)
parameters.description: Angular frequency of the electromagnetic oscillation

parameters.label: Field Amplitude (E₀)
parameters.description: Peak electric and magnetic field amplitude
